observations: At nominal 3900ms mic has expanded; cards remain straight. At 3967ms background dim and side controls disappear. At 4050ms cards and text curve and lower content blurs.
At 6917ms transcript and Thinking pill already exist; at 7333ms lens is withdrawing but text still distorted. Dimming survives the withdrawal.
4fps cropped cadence study from 3800 to 7200ms shows changing lens shape but no defensible stable oscillation period. Do not infer audio amplitude coupling.
Clip starts mid-effect; first detector window is not a clean initial condition. Later windows concern processing/response and are outside the standalone pattern.

description.one_line_summary: Holding a bottom microphone focuses capture with a rising, curved blur lens over the background while the control and transcript remain sharp.
description.detailed_description: The recording opens during a brief partial focus effect and returns to a readable suggestion list. A later hold enlarges the microphone, removes side controls and dims the context. A bowed boundary travels upward through cards, visibly distorting their edges and text before stronger blur covers the lower region. A transcript appears above the persistent microphone. The control becomes a processing pill while the lens withdraws; background dimming persists. A response later replaces the content. Only the hold/focus lens is distilled, not the response UI.

motion_breakdown.start_state: Readable cards, bottom microphone and adjacent controls; use the quiet interval before the second hold, not the already-active first frame.
motion_breakdown.transition: Mic feedback first, then dim and side-control removal; localized curved distortion/blur rises over lower content. Sharp transcript arrives independently. Processing replaces mic contents, lens retreats, dim remains until the later response transition.
motion_breakdown.end_state: For this pattern: background undistorted again, processing control still available and context still dim. Full clip ends on a response with idle microphone.
motion_breakdown.why_it_works: The persistent, sharp capture control anchors an otherwise softened and spatially displaced context; withdrawal restores legibility without falsely signaling that processing has finished.

description.confidence_note: High confidence in spatial distortion and sequence, moderate in temporal bounds; springiness is a schema label, not a recovered spring. Public title says pulse; periodicity, audio response and native implementation remain unknown.
